nodes.description: HER performance in 1.0 M KOH seawater
nodes.source_text: The Os-Co(OH)2 electrode exhibited remarkable performance in the HER when tested in a 1.0 M KOH seawater electrolyte... It achieved current densities of 10 and 500 mA cm-2 at low overpotentials of 25 and 139 mV (vs. RHE), respectively.

nodes.description: Hydrazine-assisted seawater splitting in a membraneless flow cell (MFC)
nodes.source_text: When integrated into a membraneless flow cell (MFC), the catalyst demonstrates exceptional performance in HzOR-SWE, requiring only 0.768 V to deliver 1.0 A cm -2 with a remarkable rate of 31.9 moles of hydrogen per kilowatt-hour (kWh).
Pt/C electrodes, which necessitated higher overpotentials of 28 and 259 mV (vs. RHE) to reach the same current densities... commercial Pt/C (-19.4 and 66.7 mV vs. RHE).
